seoTitle: Free Dummy File Generator: Create a File of Exact Size
metaDescription: Create a file of an exact size for upload and limit tests: zero bytes, random bytes or repeating text, up to 256 MiB. Free, built in your browser.
intro: Builds a file of the exact number of bytes you ask for and offers it as a download.
why:
When you test upload limits, quotas or slow connections, you need files of a precise size. Enter the size in bytes, KB, KiB, MB, MiB, GB or GiB and download it. Decimal units use 1000, binary units use 1024.

Zero bytes and repeating text compress to almost nothing, so choose random bytes if a server or proxy compresses uploads. The file is built in memory in your browser and is limited to 256 MiB so the tab stays responsive.

faq.a: Yes. The file has exactly the number of bytes shown in the result.

faq.q: Why is there a 256 MiB limit?
faq.a: The file is built in browser memory. Larger files could crash the tab.

faq.q: What is the difference between MB and MiB?
faq.a: MB is 1,000,000 bytes and MiB is 1,048,576 bytes.
